description: Process a is the first opener: an ADODB.Connection (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, Data Source set through the Properties collection) whose connection string carries 'Jet OLEDB:Database Locking Mode=1'; the requested and the reported property values are read after Open. Through an adOpenKeyset, adLockPessimistic ADO recordset on row 1 it assigns N (starting an edit, no Update). Process b, a DAO process opened afterwards, tries with errors recorded: UPDATE statements on row 1, row 2, row 64, and an INSERT of row 200. Process a then calls CancelUpdate and closes. Asks how the first opener's locking mode changes what a pending pessimistic edit blocks.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
